extensionDescription.message: Adds +1, replies, copying, and local favorites to Huya, Bilibili, Douyin, and Douyu Live.

settingsRepeatReminderDescription.message: Only count the most repeated text danmaku in the last minute and ask whether to +1.

settingsRepeatReminderEnabledDescription.message: Shows the radar icon on live pages; disabling it stops counting and hides the icon and prompts.

settingsRepeatReminderPromptDurationDesc.message: The prompt counts down, then hides and stays dismissed for the current window.

settingsRepeatReminderPromptScaleDescrip.message: Scale the complete frequent +1 prompt queue by percentage.

settingsRepeatReminderQueueLimitDescript.message: Keep the newest threshold prompts first and discard the oldest overflow item.

settingsRepeatReminderThresholdDescripti.message: Prompt when identical text reaches this count within the last minute.

settingsCapsuleScaleDescription.message: Scale live danmaku quick-action capsules by percentage.

settingsCopyDiagnosticsTitle.message: Copy privacy-safe diagnostics for the active live page

settingsDiagnosticsCopied.message: Page diagnostics copied (danmaku and account data excluded)

settingsDiagnosticsUnavailable.message: No supported live page found. Open a live room and try again.

settingsQuickActionsDescription.message: Detects danmaku and shows the enabled +1, Reply, Favorite, and Copy actions.

settingsPlatformDescription.message: Enable quick actions and favorites on this live platform.

toastActionTooFast.message: Too fast. Please try again shortly.

toastAccidentalSendBlocked.message: Repeated click blocked. Try again shortly.

toastDuplicateCooldown.message: That content was just sent. Try again in $SECONDS$s.

toastSendInProgress.message: The previous danmaku is still being confirmed.

toastPlatformSendUnconfirmed.message: $PLATFORM$ send was not confirmed ($SUMMARY$): no native success echo or rate-limit notice was detected.

toastSenderUnknown.message: Could not identify this danmaku sender

settingsShowPlusOneDescription.message: Show the +1 action in the danmaku toolbar.

settingsShowReplyDescription.message: Insert @sender and focus the official editor for your reply.

settingsShowFavoriteDescription.message: Save text, Unicode emoji, and platform image emotes; tap Alt+Q for the list or hold it for the wheel.

settingsShowCopyDescription.message: Copy the complete danmaku to the clipboard. Off by default; at least one quick action must remain enabled.

settingsAltClickDescription.message: Hold Alt and click a danmaku as a fallback when a live site changes its markup.

settingsSideCapsulePlatformDescription.message: Show the currently enabled quick actions when a $PLATFORM$ side-chat message is hovered.

settingsSideCapsulePlatformAria.message: Show the danmaku capsule in $PLATFORM$ side chat

settingsDouyuNativeDescription.message: Restore Douyu's own +1, Reply, and Favorite capsule. It may appear together with the extension actions.

settingsColorsDescription.message: Colors apply independently per platform. Empty values use the built-in defaults.

settingsFavoritesDescription.message: Keep reusable danmaku close at hand, including in fullscreen.

settingsFavoritesGuideDescription.message: The current room appears first. Other rooms and All open a room picker before the message list.

settingsFavoritesRichText.message: Platform image emotes and mixed content

settingsFavoritesStepSaveDescription.message: Hover a supported danmaku and select Favorite.

settingsFavoritesStepWheelDescription.message: Point to a favorite and release

settingsFavoritesPrivacyNote.message: All recognizable danmaku can be saved and remain in browser-local storage. Sending platform image emotes still requires access to that resource on the current account.

favoritesBackupDescription.message: Export JSON for safekeeping. Import keeps a local rollback copy first.

favoritesBackupFileAria.message: Choose a favorites backup JSON file

favoritesStorageUnavailable.message: Favorites storage is unavailable in this environment

favoritesBackupTooLarge.message: The backup is too large. Import canceled.

favoritesBackupInvalidJson.message: The backup is not valid JSON

favoritesBackupWrongFormat.message: This is not a Danmaku Echo favorites backup

favoritesBackupConfirm.message:
Replace current favorites with $COUNT$ items from this backup?

favoritesSubtitle.message: Save once, send in another room

favoritesDragHint.message: Drag the handle to change the wheel order, or use the move up and move down buttons

favoritesFixedOrderAria.message: Favorites in wheel order; drag a handle to reorder

favoritesWheelHint.message: Hold Alt + Q · point and release to send

favoritesReleaseToOpen.message: Release Q to open the list

favoritesCurrentSummary.message: Current-room favorites in the selected order

favoritesAllSummary.message: $COUNT$ rooms; choose one to view danmaku

favoritesNoMatchesRoomDetail.message: Try a shorter search or clear it to see all favorites in this room.

favoritesNoMatchesDetail.message: Try a shorter search or clear it to see all rooms.

favoritesCurrentEmpty.message: No favorites in this room yet

favoritesCurrentEmptyDetail.message: Hover a supported danmaku and choose Favorite. It will appear here first.

favoritesOtherEmptyDetail.message: Plain text and Unicode emoji saved in other rooms will appear here.

favoritesAllEmptyDetail.message: Favorite a message on video or in chat to send it quickly from any live room.
